description.trigger: Initiates workflows based on events in Zoho Calendar, such as calendar creation, deletion, sharing, updates, or event-related changes (create, update, delete).
description.integration: Zoho Calendar integration allows workflows to automate scheduling and calendar management. Supported triggers capture calendar or event changes, while supported actions let you create, update, or manage events and calendars in real time.

ai_description.trigger: Workflow execution starts when a calendar or event is created, updated, shared, or deleted in Zoho Calendar.
ai_description.integration: Zoho Calendar is a cloud-based scheduling and calendar management tool. It supports event-based triggers and provides actions to create, update, search, or delete events and calendars, helping users automate scheduling tasks.
